summary: Sulistio et al. identify GSE214877 in their preprint. Figure 1B compares selected markers by qRT-PCR in H9-derived cultures, Figure 1D compares htNSCs with adult GTEx brain regions, and the public bulk_DEG.xlsx reports mouse age contrasts. None supplies author effects for the registered human htNSC versus mixed-hPSC bulk RNA-seq comparison.

manualReview.summary: Deposited human counts verified. available author results address other cohorts or contrasts
manualReview.note: GSE214877 supplies StringTie sample counts. Both versions of bioRxiv 10.1101/2024.05.23.595504 name this accession. The H9 qRT-PCR panel lacks the registered mixed hPSC baseline, and the bulk transcriptome figure uses adult GTEx brain regions as comparators. The author repository’s bulk_DEG.xlsx and generating R code describe mouse aging. The preprint mentions a Supporting Data Values XLS whose contents remain unknown. See data/author-validation/continued-sources/GSE214877/codex-2026-11-21/SEARCH_LOG.md.

verificationReview.reason: The deposited matrix contains sample counts only. The preprint, its supplements and the authors’ repositories do not supply a gene-level author result for htnsc_vs_hpsc. Same-cohort effects, P values and FDR remain unassessed.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen if the authors release or identify the original bulk DESeq2 result for GSM6617220–GSM6617222 against GSM6617217–GSM6617219, with its feature identifiers, coefficient orientation and tested genes. The figure-data workbook would require the same cohort check.
